title: When characters are traumatized by these experiences, they formulate beliefs about the world that will protect them from ever again experiencing the pain of those wounds.
use_cases: Use when establishing a character's internal conflict and psychological barriers
Configure when defining the root cause of a character's resistance to change
Implement when developing the 'Lie' a character believes to drive narrative tension
Use when mapping the backstory wound to current character behavior and decision-making
content: Will Hunting believes he must have deserved those beatings, so he can never let anyone see who he really is. Sam in Sleepless In Seattle believes real love “doesn’t happen twice.” Carl in Up, Ryan in Gravity and Howard in Collateral Beauty believe that if they let go of the pain of their grief and move forward with their lives, they will lose even the memories of their loved ones – a level of pain they would never survive. And deep down, Judy Hopps believes predators really are inherently bad – regardless of what she preaches to the outside world.
